title: 第392章 番外：公主的试探
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

江浸月推开了谢霖，直奔向前方的君卿颜。

君卿颜正在用掌风击打庭院内的那棵梨树，江浸月趁她尚未发现自己的靠近，便以最快的速度绕到她身后。

君卿颜似乎有所察觉，迅速回头。

几乎是在同一时，江浸月

君卿颜动作一滞，仿佛有些头晕目眩。

江浸月连忙将手伸入袖中要去掏银针，准备扎晕君卿颜，君卿颜却蓦地抬起右手，掐住了她的脖颈！

不远处，谢霖看到这一幕，握着佩剑的手紧了紧——

公主已经疯魔，他方才阻拦县主，怕的就是县主会折在公主手上，可县主丝毫不领情，执意要上前冒险，才会造成此刻这样的局面。

走火入魔的人最可怕，他若现在出手，未必能救下县主，说不定自己也会跟着遭殃。

还是将此事禀报宁王吧。

“君卿颜你个死鬼！你当初说我化成灰你都能认得！现在怎么就认不得了！”

江浸月用双手死死地扒着君卿颜的虎口，朝她大骂，“叫你练功别心急，你非不听！你要是真掐死了我，你就后悔去吧！”

江浸月的喊声里带着颤抖。

危机近在眼前，她自然也会害怕，可她与君卿颜十几年的交情，几乎从懂事以来就是彼此最好的玩伴，要她看着君卿颜走火入魔变成残废，她是办不到的。

方才根本就来不及多想，她只希望君卿颜能够平静下来，只要她能制服了君卿颜，她们都能无事。

“颜颜，我是小月，是你最好的朋友啊……”

江浸月还在试图唤醒君卿颜。

而下一刻，她便感觉掐着自己的力度有所放松。

江浸月心下大喜，她见君卿颜神色变得茫然，心中猜测着应该是刚才撒的迷香起作用了。

趁着君卿颜恍惚，她赶紧取出了随身携带的银针，扎在了君卿颜的手腕处。

君卿颜手腕一麻，顿时使不上劲，江浸月紧扣住她的手腕，又迅速绕到她身后，朝她的脖颈处也扎了一针。

君卿颜缓缓合上了眼皮，整个身躯软了下来。

江浸月连忙扶着她缓缓坐下，抬头怒视前方站着的谢霖。

没用的东西！方才这厮若是肯帮忙，她早就把颜颜制服了，都不用被掐脖子。

Page (1/3)

Jiang Jinyue pushed Xie Lin away and ran straight to Jun Qingyan in front.

Jun Qingyan was hitting the pear tree in the courtyard with the wind of her palm. Jiang Jinyue walked around behind her as quickly as possible before she noticed her approach.

Jun Qingyan seemed to notice something and quickly turned around.

Almost at the same time, Jiang Jinyue

Jun Qingyan's movements were stagnant, as if she was a little dizzy.

Jiang Jinyue quickly reached into her sleeve to take out the silver needle, preparing to stun Jun Qingyan, but Jun Qingyan suddenly raised her right hand and pinched her neck!

Not far away, Xie Lin saw this scene and tightened his hand on the sword——

The princess has gone crazy, and he just stopped the county lord because he was afraid that the county lord would fall into the hands of the princess, but the county lord didn't appreciate it at all and insisted on taking risks, which led to the current situation.

The most terrifying thing is a person who is obsessed with madness. If he takes action now, he may not be able to save the county owner, and he may also suffer disaster.

It is better to report this matter to Prince Ning.

"Jun Qingyan, you damn ghost! You said you could recognize me when I turned into ashes! Why can't you recognize me now!"

Jiang Jinyue grabbed Jun Qingyan's mouth with both hands and yelled at her, "Don't be impatient when I tell you to practice, but you won't listen! If you really strangle me to death, you will regret it!"

Jiang Jinyue's shout was trembling.

The crisis was so close that she would naturally be afraid, but she and Jun Qingyan had been friends for more than ten years and had been each other's best playmates almost since they were sensible. She couldn't do it if she had to watch Jun Qingyan become obsessed and become disabled.

She didn't have time to think too much just now. She just hoped that Jun Qingyan could calm down. As long as she could subdue Jun Qingyan, they would be fine.

"Yanyan, I am Xiaoyue, I am your best friend..."

Jiang Jinyue is still trying to wake up Jun Qingyan.

The next moment, she felt that the pinch on her had relaxed.

Jiang Jinyue was overjoyed. Seeing Jun Qingyan's expression become confused, she guessed that the scent she spread just now had an effect.

While Jun Qingyan was in a daze, she quickly took out the silver needle she carried with her and pierced Jun Qingyan's wrist.

Jun Qingyan's wrist went numb and she couldn't exert any strength. Jiang Jinyue grabbed her wrist tightly, quickly went around behind her, and stabbed her neck with a needle.

Jun Qingyan slowly closed her eyelids and her whole body softened.

Jiang Jinyue quickly helped her sit down slowly, raised her head and glared at Xie Lin standing in front of her.

Useless stuff!If this guy was willing to help just now, she would have subdued Yan Yan long ago without being choked.
